description: Expand an iCalendar RFC 5545 RRULE (recurring event rule, as used by Google Calendar, Outlook, CalDAV) into concrete occurrences in any IANA zone, DST-correct, with an English description. Supports FREQ (yearly … secondly), INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYMONTH, BYWEEKNO, BYYEARDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYDAY with ordinals (2MO, -1FR), BYHOUR / BYMINUTE / BYSECOND, BYSETPOS, WKST, plus EXDATE / RDATE and an after / before window. Accepts a bare rule or full DTSTART + RRULE lines. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/rrule-expand

after.description: Only occurrences at or after this time

before.description: Only occurrences at or before this time

dtstart.description: First occurrence (ISO 8601 local time in tz); overrides a DTSTART line

rrule.description: RRULE value, optionally with DTSTART / RRULE / EXDATE / RDATE lines

name: rrule_expand
title: Rrule Expand
